description: A Flutter widget implementing a splash/routing screen that determines the next screen based on user preferences and navigates accordingly. It displays a centered icon, app name, progress bar, and footer text.

classes.name: SecondScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the splash/routing screen shown after first app run.

classes.name: _SecondScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the routing logic and UI for SecondScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and triggers routing after a delay.

methods.name: _routeAfterDelay
methods.description: Handles delayed routing based on user preferences, determining the next screen.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the splash screen UI with icon, app name, progress bar, and footer text.
